subject: criteria to select info about sleep days

messages.author: a239a3848efbd789
messages.subject: criteria to select info about sleep days
parts:
Hi Vincent, quick question. I am collecting data with a challenging sample of participants (complex sleep patterns). 
I don't understand why I am getting only few days of summary data (not in a sequence) as you can see in the picture below. 
For example, this participant has data for 17 days (part 2 summary). 
I want to know if this "selection" is driven by the behaviors of my participants or something about the syntax. 
I have used GGIR before without problem. Now using new updated version. 
Thank you
Guillermo

messages.author: a239a3848efbd789
messages.subject: criteria to select info about sleep days
parts:
Hello, I was able to solve the problem using
def.noc.sleep.

My interpretation about discrepancy is because there are days where participants were considered (correctly) day sleepers.
Let me know if my interpretation is right.
Regards.
Guillermo
